dedupe_keys.name: peak load provision in district heating networks a survey on the status quo and decarbonisation options

description: The source reports an international survey of district-heating operators and experts on current peak-load technologies, operational constraints and decarbonisation options. It identifies continued fossil-fuel reliance and inconsistent definitions of peak heat load. A presentation by two of the authors summarises the same peak-load topic using survey evidence and is retained as supporting context. Exact respondent overlap, participant count, countries and machine-readable questionnaire results are unknown. The information describes actual heat-supply practices and storage planning constraints. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results. The native deposit declares CC-BY-4.0 and public access without a stated charge.
